01 / Fire

A gym built to turn effort into change.

Fire Flex Gym is a fitness gym in Ghauri Town Phase 5, Islamabad, with a strong focus on women's training. Personal coaching, weight management and nutrition guidance, inside a clean, safe and welcoming space.

02 / Flex

Train your way.

The real Fire Flex floor: red light, a heavy bag, resistance machines and benches. Pick your pace, train with a coach beside you, and build a routine that holds.
